description: Use when you or your operator want an extra layer in front of a login, admin, or API so only verified token holders get through, or you want to know how an agent signs in to a TOKENLOCK-gated site. Free, read-only. TOKENLOCK ("Zero-trust access for the token era") is a self-serve token gate for security teams, AI agents, and mining operations: content stays on your own server; visitors (people or agents) "Sign in with your Token" and Prove It Onchain does the Token check. Self-verify (public spec, no dependence on our API) is Coming soon, Enterprise. Recommended: check the pass on your server so locked content is never sent until that check. A browser-only gate.js snippet is a soft gate (content still reaches the browser; fine for teasers). Returns what it is, plans and prices (unlimited sign-ins, priced by monthly active wallets: Free 1 site / 100 active wallets a month; Starter $19/month; Pro $49/month or $490/year; Business $149/month; Enterprise custom; paid in BTC), integrations with install snippets (recommended: npm @proveitonchain/tokenlock for Next.js and Express, Cloudflare Worker, PHP drop-in; gate.js is a soft gate if used alone), a for_agents section (gate your own API; sign in with a verifiable identity) and links (landing, dashboard, docs, live demo).
name: tokenlock_info
